title: brazil presidential hopeful bolsonaro under investigation over alleged 2026 09 11
text:
BRASILIA, Sept 11 (Reuters) - Brazil's Supreme Court opened an investigation ​in July into Senator ‌Flavio Bolsonaro over alleged corruption and money laundering crimes ​as part of a ​broader probe into failed lender ⁠Banco Master, according ​to a court document unsealed on ​Friday.
The eldest son of former President Jair Bolsonaro is the ​leading right-wing challenger to ​leftist President Luiz Inacio Lula da ‌Silva ⁠in next month's election.
The investigation into Flavio Bolsonaro was opened by Justice ​Andre ​Mendonca following ⁠a request from Brazil's Federal Police, ​which pointed to ​donations ⁠made by Banco Master's former chief executive Daniel Vorcaro ⁠to ​a movie ​about the senator's father.
